title: Coherent natural raw pullbacks for varying abelian coefficients
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ any preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ any diagram with cone $c$. Write $g_i:X_i\to S$, $g:X\to S$, $a_f:X_j\to X_i$ and $a_i:X\to X_i$ for its structure, transition and cone maps. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with coefficient maps $\varphi_f:a_f^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], satisfying the canonical identity and composition HEq equations of the Lean signature. Let $H:I\to\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mathbf{Ab})$ have a colimit, with $eH_i:H_i\simeq a_i^{-1}F_i$ and canonical transition equation $H(f)=eH_i;\mathrm{upperStarComp};a_j^{-1}(\varphi_f);eH_j^{-1}$. Fix $p\in\mathbf N$. Put $A_i=\mathrm{raw}(g_i,p,F_i)$ and $Z=\mathrm{raw}(g,p,\operatorname{colim}H)$, the derived-Hom presheaves of [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison]. There exist natural transformations $\tau_f:A_i\to A_j$ and $\beta_i:A_i\to Z$, whose components at every etale $V\to S$ are the explicit raw pullbacks along $(a_f,\varphi_f)$ and $(a_i,eH_i^{-1};\iota_i)$ respectively. They satisfy $\tau_{1_i}=1$, $\tau_{f;f'}=\tau_f;\tau_{f'}$ and $\tau_f;\beta_j=\beta_i$. No directedness, nonemptiness, limit, affineness or qcqs assumption is needed.

proof.text: Bundle each explicit raw function additively: derived pullback is additive and precomposition/postcomposition with the fixed source, single, shift and coefficient factors are additive. For restrictions of etale objects, naturality of inverse-image composition and the single-functor comparison moves the free-sheaf restriction past the first two factors; preservation of composition by derived pullback moves it past the class. This gives the naturality square. Thus these homomorphisms define tau and beta with exactly the prescribed components.

For identities expand the five factors, identify the coefficient map using hphiid, and cancel the single comparisons through the identity coherence of inverse image. For composition map the inner factors through the outer pullback, use single-comparison naturality to cancel adjacent direct and inverse comparisons, apply associativity of inverse-image composition and hphicomp to the source and coefficient factors, and combine the shift comparisons. Extensionality at every test object gives the identity and composition equalities of natural transformations.

Substitute hH in the limit coefficient maps and use H.map f followed by colimit.ι H j equals colimit.ι H i. Cancel eH j with its inverse. The same composite pullback calculation now proves tau f followed by beta j equals beta i.
